rationale.campaign_length: 部族前传之后才进入54项I98专属任务。
rationale.colonization: 路线重心在现有地下领土、工业与对外贸易，而非海外殖民。
rationale.complexity: 形成门槛、五派影响、狂飙刻度、灾难及高成本任务需并行管理。
rationale.dark_story: 工业事故、金融伤害与破坏性武器被荒诞口吻包装。
rationale.difficulty: 形成国前置与后续经济、派系和灾难门槛均较高。
rationale.diplomacy: 形成条件涉及对其他四部的臣服或吞并，外交并非主轴。
rationale.early_pressure: 在获得I98专属树前必须完成大范围西蛇脊统一。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 奇械发明与工业实验是国家的核心辨识度。
rationale.narrative_density: 五派政治、狂热建设、灾难、探险与金融骗局串起长线故事。
rationale.tall_play: 矿堡、工厂、铁路与极端建设要求占据战役大篇幅。
rationale.trade_economy: 铁路、药业、商贸、金融和工业生产密集交织。
rationale.warfare: 指定部族须先统一西蛇脊，后期任务继续推动军备和扩张。

identity.appearance: 1444年并不存在；由五个指定西蛇脊洞穴哥布林国家之一完成条件后形成

survey_region.note: Ves Udzenklan为I98独立来源行（Rank 47）；The Overclan是另一国家，见F78的Rank 26，未合并。

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 挖掘领地、矿井、采石场和隧道是一件复杂的事情，因为蛇脊山脉是由各种岩石和矿物层扭曲而成的。值得庆幸的是，地精对炸药的喜爱又一次派上了用场。虽然在挖掘中使用炸药很危险，但如果使用得当，可以提高我们的工作时间。只要让明火远离引信...
description.text_en: Excavating holds, mineshafts, quarries, and tunnels is a complicated matter, as the Serpentspine is a twisted mess of various layers of rock and mineral. Thankfully, the goblin fondness for explosives comes in handy once again. While using explosives in excavations is dangerous, it can improve our work times if used properly. Just keep open flame away from the fuses…

description.text: 众氏族之国，就其本质而言，是一项不朽的发明，它使地精前所未有地团结起来。这项发明将激励更多的人，因为我们形成了一个能够实现真正的、无与伦比的进步的国家，这一点是世界上前所未有的。大地的骨骼将随着我们天才的雷声而颤抖，洞穴的黑暗将被我们思想的光辉所驱逐。
description.text_en: The Allclan, by its very nature, is a monumental invention that has united goblinkind like never before. This invention shall be one that inspires many more, as we form a state capable of real, unrivaled progress unlike anything the world has seen before. The very bones of the earth will shake with the thunder of our genius and the darkness of the caves will be banished by the brilliance of our minds.

description.text: 曾经，地精和矮人为了争夺洞穴和隧道而大打出手，矮人及时地从大地上凿出了他们的铁轨和支架，并摧毁了地精组织自己的任何企图。然后，兽人来了，他们杀死了矮人，并奴役了我们中的许多人。这样的情况持续了几千年，但现在随着兽人和不幸的许多亲属被清空，我们已经能够为整个地精打造一个真正的家园。让我们确保众氏族永远是所有地精的家园。
description.text_en: Once, goblins and dwarves fought over the caves and tunnels, with the dwarves in time carving their rails and holds from the earth itself, and destroying any attempt for goblinkind to organize itself likewise. Then, the orcs came, and killed the dwarves and enslaved many of us. Such was so for millennia, but now with the emptying of the Serpentspine of orcs and unfortunately, many of our kin, we have been able to forge a true home for all of goblinkind. Let us ensure that the Allclan remains a home for all of goblinkind forevermore.

description.text: 进步的车轮在转动，但什么在转动？是我们的人民实现创新的动力。但有时，车轮会停滞。灵感减退，动力不足，因为已经达到了极限。有时，为了取得进展，需要越过界限。这是不幸的，我们将不得不确保将残酷的事情保持在必要的最低限度。当然，我们不会在试图取得突破的过程中把道德抛到窗外。至少，在有人关注的时候……
description.text_en: The wheels of progress turn, but what turns them? The drive of our people to achieve innovation. But sometimes, the wheels stall. Inspiration falters and drive runs flat as limitations are reached. Sometimes, lines need to be crossed for progress to be made. This is unfortunate, and we will have to ensure that cruelties are kept to a necessary minimum. We will not, of course, throw morals out the window in our attempts to make breakthroughs. At least, while anyone is watching…

description.text: 从最偏远的岩洞到最勤劳的船坞，土地的使用都由政府精心管理，以确保最大效率。工程师和城市规划师接受过横向和纵向空间最大化的培训，确保住房、商业和工业都能适当地同步协调。当然，有时由于新的分区需求的出现，一些地区需要被拆除或改变，但政府的职责是确保一切都像一台上好油的机器一样运作。如果少数人必须被踢到路边，那又如何？
description.text_en: From the most remote cavern to the most industrious hold, land usage is meticulously managed by the government to ensure maximum efficiency. Engineers and town planners, trained in the art of maximizing space both horizontal and vertical, ensure that housing, commerce, and industry are all properly in synchronous harmony. Of course, sometimes areas need to be demolished or changed as new zoning needs come into light, but it is the government's duty to ensure everything works like a well oiled machine. If a few must be kicked to the curb, what of it?

description.text: 奇械术是众氏族之国跳动的心脏，为了确保它的标准保持不变，必须有专门的机构来规范这种做法，而且还要教授它。行会和孤独的教员-学徒关系不可能成为我们所设想的正规工业经济规模的基础。因此，众氏族之国奇械术和战争学院的建立，将使我们能够培养出有创造力的、最关键的、为国家服务的忠诚的头脑。让疯狂的发明家感到对国家的亏欠，而不是被国家所蔑视......
description.text_en: Artifice is the beating heart of the Allclan, and in order to ensure its standards are kept up to snuff, there must be institutions dedicated not only to regulating the practice, but also teaching it. Guilds and lone instructor-apprentice relationships cannot be the basis for a formal, industrial economy at the scale that we envision. Hence, the foundation of the Allclan College of Artifice and War, which will allow us to cultivate inventive and most critical of all, loyal minds in service to the State. Better to have the mad inventor feel indebted to the State rather than scorned by it...

name.text: 众氏族之国奇械术和战争学院
name.text_en: Allclan College of Artifice and War

description.text: 众氏族之国将所有的地精聚集在一起，无论他们是否生活在我们的边界。通过创建一个统一的现代工业国家，我们不仅为地精，而且为其他寻求我们的知识和专长的人创造了一个模式。众氏族之国是一个闪亮的证明，说明只要有合适的机会，一个所谓的野蛮人或怪物可以取得什么成就。自然，我们必须首先确保我们自己的成功，即使是以牺牲野蛮人和怪物的利益为代价。
description.text_en: The Allclan has brought all of goblinkind together, whether or not they live in our borders. By creating a unified and modern industrial state, we have created a model for not only goblins but others who seek our knowledge and expertise. The Allclan stands as a shining testament to what a so-called savage or monstrous people can achieve when given the right opportunity. Naturally, we must ensure our own success first and foremost, even if it comes at the expense of the savage and monstrous.

description.text: 在我们的历史上，矮人之地的铁路一直是我们氏族的家园，但随着杜坎森奴役了许多地精氏族并带走了矮人之地的兽人，一个征服交轨大厅——我们称之为家园的铁路网的中心——的机会出现了。其经费将来自于铁路什一税制，运用这一制度，我们勒索或者强迫任何想在铁路上移动的地精氏族或足够小的兽人战团交出他们的一部分财富和奴隶。随着时间的推移，这一制度使我们能够建立必要的力量，以夺取铁路之心，我们现在所称的家园。
description.text_en: The rails of the Dwarovar have been our Clan's home for as far as our histories tell, but with Dookanson enslaving many goblin clans and emptying the Dwarovar of orcs, an opportunity arose to conquer Er-Natvir, the heart of the rail network which we call home. The cost was paid with the Rail-tithe, a system where we extorted or forced any goblin clan or small enough orcish warband that wanted to move over the railways to give over a portion of their wealth and slaves. In time, this system allowed us to build the forces necessary to take the Heart of the Rails that we now call home.

description.text: 交轨大厅是我们氏族的心脏，部族也给它一个贴切的称号「铁路之心」，因为古代矮人就是在这里保持着他们铁轨的跳动之心。成千上万辆马车的锈迹斑斑的残骸，曾经以我们不知道的方式移动，现在只剩下烧毁或毁坏的金属残骸。许多族人最想做的就是修理这些机器，当然只是为了让它更适合地精使用。现在，我们不得不用奴隶拉车来应付。
description.text_en: Er-Natvir is the heart of our clan, and the clan has given it an apt title of 'The Heart of the Rails' as well, for it was here the ancient dwarves kept the beating heart of their rails going. The rusted wrecks of thousands of carts, which were once moved by ways we do not know, are now no more than burnt out or ruined hulks of metal. Many of the clan would love for nothing more than to repair one of these machines, only of course to make it more fitting for a goblin. For now, we'll have to make do with slaves pulling the carts.

description.text: 自从我们在1431年到达交轨大厅以来，我们已经成长壮大，成为我们所知的矮人之地中最大和最有组织的地精氏族，考虑到兽人突袭者和无组织的对手的数量，这是相当大的成就。不过，这还不够。侦察员报告说，冒险的矮人队伍已经回到了矮人之地，不管他们经历了怎样的流放，很可能都是杜坎森带走了蛇脊山脉的兽人和地精导致的结果。我们必须把交轨大厅变成一个牢不可破的堡垒，因为毫无疑问，会有矮人为了自己的家园而寻找我们的家园。交轨大厅必须成为所有地精的家园——当然是在我们氏族的统治下。
description.text_en: Since our arrival in Er-Natvir in 1431, we have grown and expanded, becoming the largest and most organized goblin clan in the Dwarovar to our knowledge, which is quite the feat considering the number of orc raiders and disorganized rivals. Still, it is not enough. Scouts report bands of adventuring dwarves have returned to the Dwarovar, from whatever exile they have endured, likely as a consequence of Dookanson emptying the Serpentspine of both orcs and goblins. We must turn Er-Natvir into an unbreakable fortress, as no doubt there will be dwarves who will seek our home for their own. Er-Natvir must become a home for all goblins- under our clan's rule, of course.

description.text: 在领地的下层深处有一个非凡的发现，似乎许多伟大的轨道机器都是在那里维护的。其中一台机器是一个巨大的移动铸造厂，从船上发现的材料来看，它能够完整地制造新的达格银轨道。虽然它似乎没有能力自行铺设，但它肯定会使铁路维修变得更快。虽然我们还不能完全挖掘它，因为机器太深了，但我们可以研究它，到时候也许可以学会如何利用它来达到我们自己的目的。
description.text_en: A remarkable discovery has been made in the lower depths of the hold, where it seems many of the great rail-machines were maintained. One of these machines is a massive mobile foundry, and from the materials found aboard, is capable of creating new dagrite rails in their entirety. While it doesn't seem capable of laying them on its own, it certainly would make rail repairs much quicker. While we cannot quite yet excavate it as the machine is far too deep, we can study it and in time perhaps learn how to make use of it for our own ends.

description.text: 我们铁路潜伏者氏族一直对新的想法持开放态度，即使只是出于需要而不是渴望。然而，最近，氏族内许多人的观念逐渐发生了巨大的变化。自称为「技术官僚」的新个人已经变得很有影响力，在某些位置上甚至上升到了氏族内的领导地位。他们主张为我们的人民制定新的目标。一个不是简单的征服和掠夺，就像我们的祖先曾经做过的那样。他们主张改变一个更宏大的目标——促进地精的技术、安全和繁荣。
description.text_en: We of the Railskulker clan have always been open to new ideas, if only more so out of necessity than desire. Lately however there has been a gradual, if great shift in the outlook of many in the clan. New individuals, calling themselves 'Technocrats' have become influential and even rising to positions of leadership in the clan. They have advocated for a new purpose for our people. One not of simple conquest and pillaging, as our ancestors once did. They advocate a change to a grander goal - Of furthering the technology, security and prosperity of goblinkind.

description.text: 铁路潜伏者氏族有一个悠久的传统，就是每年召开一次会议，决定对氏族来说非常重要的事情。然而，随着技术官僚的崛起，其目的已经从非正式辩论和侮辱对手的目的改变了。随着我们采用更正式的统治体系，技术官僚正在利用这些年度会议来打断他们的发明、无厘头的辩论和奇怪的想法。族长决定，给他们一个特别的议会，可以让他们不参与政治事务，让我们其他人可以平静地互相侮辱。
description.text_en: It has always been a long standing tradition of the Railskulker clan to have yearly meetings to decide on matters of great importance to the clan. With the rise of the Technocrats however, the purpose has changed from that of informal debate and insulting of rivals. As we adopt a more formal system of rule, the Technocrats are using these yearly meetings to interrupt with their inventions, nonsensical debates and strange ideas. The Clanboss has determined that giving them a special council will keep them out of political affairs and allow the rest of us to insult each other in peace.

effects.display: 统治者同文化顾问花费：-15%
effects.label_zh: 统治者同文化顾问花费

description.text: 虽然由于我们族人不太有组织和返回的矮人阻止，我们对矮人之地的征服并没有像我们所希望的那样迅速，但我们仍然因为一个地精的矮人之地的梦想而团结在一起。现在这个梦有了名字。韦斯乌任克兰，众氏族之国，一个团结所有地精的国家，不论效忠于谁或出身如何。一个探索科技奇迹的国家。一个将我们的人民提升到矮人和兽人无法企及的伟大境界的国度。我们将使这个梦想成为现实，并确保我们占据我们的位置，成为蛇脊山脉的真正统治者。
description.text_en: The conquest of the Dwarovar has been slower than we would like, due to a combination of our less organized kin and returning dwarves. But this has not changed that we are still united by a dream of a home for all goblinkind. Various technocrats of a more philosophical bent have given that dream a name; Ves Udzenklan, the All Clan. A state they say, to unite all goblins regardless of allegiance or origin. A state to explore the wonders of technology. A state to elevate our people to the greatness that dwarves and orcs have kept us from. We will make this dream a reality, and ensure that we take our place as the true rulers of the Serpentspine.

description.text: 曾经有一段时间，地精自由地漫游在蛇脊山脉，没有人压迫他们。许多氏族与矮人和兽人斗争，但没有一个氏族需要忍受我们所遭受的痛苦。作为黑皮兽人战队的奴隶，我们是最底层的人，我们的价值还不如我们睡过的泥土。但在我们的内心深处，有一个想法在涌动。一个微弱的希望的记忆，有一天我们可以再次获得自由。这个希望培养了我们，加强了我们的决心。只有通过这几十年的隐秘抵抗，我们才能最终从兽人手中获得自由。
description.text_en: There was once a time where goblins roamed the Serpentspine freely, without anyone to oppress them. Many clans struggled against dwarves and orcs, but none other had to endure the pain we had been subjected to. As slaves to a black orc warband we were the lowest of the low, we were worth less than the dirt we slept on. But deep in our hearts there stirred a thought. A faint memory of hope that someday we could be free once more. This hope nurtured us, strengthened our resolve. It is only through these decades of hidden resistance that we could eventually gain our freedom from the orcs.

description.text: 杜坎森的崛起意味着几乎所有的兽人战团都离开了蛇脊山脉，留下了一个巨大的权力真空，正慢慢被从永恒的阴影中爬出来的无数地精所填补。如果我们想在这个世界上保持相关性，我们必须抓紧时间，用我们自己的地精亲属填补这些空荡荡的大厅，他们为我们服务，而且只为我们服务。
description.text_en: The rise of Dookanson meant that almost all orc warbands had left the Serpentspine, leaving behind a gigantic power vacuum that is slowly being filled by the innumerous goblins crawling out of the eternal shadow. If we want to stay relevant in this world we must make haste and fill these empty halls with our own goblin kin who serve us and only us.

description.text: 为了在严酷的蛇脊山脉中生存，氏族头目只需要他身边最有能力的顾问。但在一个像蛇脊山脉这样由可怕的纷争和血腥的战斗铸就的世界里，如果他们不能战斗，一个简单的学者是没有用的。为了证明一个顾问能够在这个世界上生存下去，他们需要为自己的地位而战。无论谁想领导，都必须打败他面前的人。这样一来，只有真正的强者才会成为向氏族头目提供国家事务建议的人。
description.text_en: To survive in the harsh world of the Serpentspine the Clanboss needs only the most capable advisors around him. But in a world forged by fearsome strife and bloody battles such as the Serpentspine a simple academic is useless if they can’t fight. To prove that an advisor can survive the world they need to fight for their place. Whoever wishes to lead must defeat the one in front of him. This way only the truly strong will be the ones to advise the Clanboss on matters of state.

description.text: 我们部族中残酷的顾问们对他们的服务要求很高，这给我们的国库带来了巨大的财政压力。为了减轻他们的负担，我们不用金币而是秘银硬币来补充他们的报酬，由于我们的家园——秘银地的秘银领地，我们拥有相对丰富的资源。这种秘银币使我们能够将黄金用于其他用途。
description.text_en: The brutal advisors of our clan demand high pay for their services which has put significant financial strain on our treasuries. To ease the burden we have supplemented their pay with coins not made of gold but of mithril, which we have in relative abundance thanks to our home, the mithril hold of Mithradhûm. This mithril coinage enables us to put our gold to other use.

description.text: 在众矮人之国陷落之后，许多领地和道路都充满了古老的矮人机械和战争机器。那些没有被游荡的黑皮兽人战队毁坏的机械仍然可以派上一些用场。特别是那些古老的大炮和火器，一旦用我们能在其他地方找到的东西进行装备和修理，就很有用。这些拼凑起来的武器相当厚重，而且让我们高兴的是，我们发现它们留下的不止伤痕和蓝斑。
description.text_en: Left in the wake of the fall of Aul-Dwarov many holds and roads are full of ancient dwarven mechanisms and machinery of war. Those that have not been trashed by roaming black orc warbands can still be put to some use. Especially the old cannons and firearms are useful once they are outfitted and repaired with what we can find elsewhere. These patchwork weapons are quite hefty and to our delight we have found that they leave more than a few scars and blue spots.

description.text: 虽然钻头和镐头是完全合适的工具，可以划开蛇脊山脉的岩石，但如果我们想快速挖下去，就没有什么用了。为此，我们需要从我们的秘银火炮中发射炸药，炸掉所有无用的岩石，并释放出珍贵、闪亮的金属，以与我们获得自由时对我们的战队所做的一样的方式抹去周围的石头。这些新的采矿方法将向世界展示什么是真正意义上的挖矿。
description.text_en: While drills and pickaxes are perfectly suitable tools to scratch the rock of the Serpentspine they are not much use if we want to dig down fast. For that we need to blast away all of the useless rock by firing explosives from our mithril-cannons and free the precious, shiny metals, obliterating the surrounding stone in much the same way as we did to our warband when we gained freedom. These new mining practices will show the world what it truly means to dig a mine.

description.text: 我们部族的名字来自「鲨鱼」格洛佐克，他是把我们从奴隶制中解放并带来自由的地精。在他的领导下，我们已经不仅仅是一群破烂不堪的战士。时至今日，正是他的猛烈智慧指引着我们和我们的氏族头目走向未来。群山之鲨的每一个地精都试图模仿他向我们展示的天才、狡猾和不可思议的暴力。
description.text_en: Our clan’s name comes from Glozok the Shark, the goblin who brought us out of slavery and into freedom. Under his leadership we have become more than a ragtag group of warriors. To this day it is his fierce wisdom that guides us and our Clanboss into the future. Each goblin of Mountainshark tries to emulate the genius, the cunning, and the incredible violence which he showed us.

description.text: 真匕的氏族头目雇用了许多刺客和杀手来惩罚违法者，或者那天晚上吃饭时碰巧和他们过不去的人。偷窃族人的东西，或者更糟糕的是偷窃氏族头目的东西，就会招来背后的刀和脖子上的绞索。叛国罪的惩罚更加无情，犯错的地精会被用铁丝穿过手臂，打断腿，然后被前面提到的铁丝吊在柱子上，悬在空中数尺。死亡是缓慢而残酷的，任何试图帮助受惩罚者的人反而会受到同样的惩罚。
description.text_en: The Clanboss of the Truedagger Clan employs many assassins and cutthroats for punishing breakers of the law, or whoever happened to cross them that evening at dinner. To steal from the Clan, or worse, the Clanboss, is to invite a knife to your back and a garrote around your throat. Treason is even more ruthlessly punished, with the offending goblin or goblins having wire run through their arms, their legs broken, and then strung up on posts by earlier mentioned wire, dangling several feet in the air. Death is slow and cruel, and any attempting to aid the punished will instead join them.

description.text: 随着蛇脊山脉的清空，矮人已经回来了。许多其他氏族可能会把这看作是对我们生存的关键威胁，因为他们带着新的武器、新的战术和远比那些逃到世界上任何被误解的角落的祖先更热心。然而，矮人是习惯和传统的动物，他们对开垦的重视可以像任何弱点一样被利用。如果我们不得不与他们作战，我们可以用一些矮人的「遗物」在这里和那里轻松地转移他们的奴性奉献和短暂的注意力。他们自然会寻求回收本质上是垃圾的东西，在我们面前分化自己。
description.text_en: With the emptying of the Serpentspine, the dwarves have returned. Many other clans may see this as a critical threat to our existence, as they come armed with new weapons, new tactics and far more zeal than the ancestors which fled to whatever misbegotten corner of the world they had dug to. However, dwarves are creatures of habit and tradition, and the importance they place on their reclamation can be exploited like any weakness. Should we have to combat them, we can easily divert their slavish devotion and short attention spans with a few dwarven "relics" here and there. They will naturally seek to recover what is essentially trash, dividing themselves before us.

description.text: 真匕氏族的地精喜欢很多东西，比如刀子、飞镖、网子，等等。他们同样喜欢决斗、争吵和其他暴力的表现，甚至不一定是两个地精之间。最近，被俘虏的奴隶，无论是地精、兽人还是矮人，经常在大张旗鼓的竞技场上互相对决。野兽和怪物之间的战斗也很常见，而奴隶与怪物的对决是群众特别喜欢的。奴隶们的武器越少越好。
description.text_en: The goblins of Clan Truedagger are fond of many things, such as knives, darts, nets, and the like. They are just as fond of duels, brawls, and other expressions of violence, not even necessarily between two goblins. As of late, captured slaves, be they goblin, orc, or dwarf, are often pitted against each other in vastly publicized arena fights. Fights between beasts and monsters are also common, and slaves versus monsters is a particular favourite of the crowds. The less armed the slaves, the better.

description.text: 一般来说，地精是非常没有耐心的。许多地精只是在寻找一种方法来超越他们的邻居，或者寻找最快速的成功途径。这是我们民族最伟大的资产之一，因为它促使我们前进。但真匕氏族孕育了比一般人更聪明的地精。有耐心的时候，也有权宜之计的时候。毕竟，如果你的对手注定要失败，为什么要急于求成？特别是当你可以用他们所付出的一半努力，让他们摔得更惨的时候？
description.text_en: Goblins are, generally speaking, very impatient. Many goblins are simply looking for a way to one-up their neighbor, or the quickest route to success. This is one of our people's greatest assets, as it drives us forward. But Clan Truedagger breeds a smarter goblin than the average. There is a time for patience and a time for expediency. Why rush, after all, if your opponent is doomed to fail? Especially when you can, with half the effort they put in, make them fall twice as far?

description.text: 在战争中，没有什么是公平的。敌人，无论其性质如何，都必须在身体和精神上被击垮。实现这一目标的方法有很多，但真匕氏族发现其中一个特别有用的方法是突袭。允许我们的战士在战役中不受限制地进行掠夺和抢劫，是一种极好的激励，不仅可以在他们的同伴也在乡间进行掠夺时快速通过领土，而且可以在围攻期间保持高昂的士气。
description.text_en: In warfare, nothing is fair. The enemy, regardless of their nature, must be broken in both body and spirit. There are many ways to achieve this, but one that Clan Truedagger finds particularly useful is raiding. By allowing our warriors unrestricted rights to pillage and plunder during campaigns is an excellent incentive to not only move quickly through territory, as their fellow soldiers also plunder the countryside, but keep morale high during sieges.

description.text: 什么使一个领导者值得追随？尊重？恐惧？暴力？真匕氏族的氏族头目必须混合使用这三者，但并不总是同等程度。有时，氏族头目必须既尊重又畏惧，或者既畏惧又血腥。或者是暴力和尊重。一个能够使用这三者的氏族头目是一个成功的氏族头目，一个不能激发这三者的氏族头目将不能长久地成为氏族头目。
description.text_en: What makes a leader worth following? Respect? Fear? Violence? The Clanboss of the Truedagger Clan must use a mixture of all three, but not always in equal measure. Sometimes, a Clanboss must be respected and feared, or feared and bloodied. Or violent and respected. A Clanboss who can use and be all three is a successful Clanboss, a Clanboss that fails to inspire these will not be Clanboss for long.

description.text: 火炮是地精的最爱，这是我们族人一个简单而基本的事实。然而，找到适当利用这种喜爱的方法稍微困难一些。就目前的情况来看，大炮是一种笨重的东西，不适合由地精携带。然而，一个修补匠突然想到了一种方法，可以制造一门更轻的大炮，八个地精可以搬运，其中两个是用来携带火药和弹药的。尽管体积很小，但这些快速部署的大炮在准备充分的情况下，能够被安置在难以到达的地方，进行毁灭性的伏击和巧妙的炮击。
description.text_en: Goblins are fond of explosives, this is a simple, fundamental fact of our people. Finding ways to properly harness this fondness, however, is slightly more difficult. As it stands, cannons are bulky, heavy things unfit to be carried by a goblin. However, one tinkerer has happened upon a method of making a lighter cannon, capable of being carried by a team of eight goblins, two of which are reserved for carrying the powder and ammunition. Though small, these rapidly deployable cannons are capable of being set up in harder to reach places with enough preparation, allowing for devastating ambushes and clever cannonfire.

description.text: 从最早的时候起，粗鄙中指氏族就有了战斗侮辱的传统，最初的设计是为了引诱兽人进入准备好的伏击。随着氏族的发展，这一传统也在不断发展。许多地精把他们的业余时间用来完善对对手和朋友的新侮辱。现在，如今，他们的侮辱技巧不仅被用来嘲弄敌人，还成为外交和谈判手段。
description.text_en: Since their earliest days, the Snotfinger Clan has practiced a tradition of insults, initially designed to lure orcs into prepared ambushes. As the clan moves forward, so too has this tradition. Many goblins spend their spare time perfecting new insults for both rivals and friends. Now their insult skills are not only used to taunt the enemy into their demise, but have also become a tool of diplomacy and negotiation.

effects.display: 从侮辱得到的力量投射：+1
effects.label_zh: 从侮辱得到的力量投射

description.text:
在绿潮突破玛瑙之门攻击东坎诺之前，地精奴隶鲁尔诺尔·粗鄙中指带领一群地精奴隶进入附近的洞穴，避免了那些普通地精的命运。粗鄙中指的每一个地精都知道这个故事，也知道为什么与兽人永远无法和平相处的真相。他们都必须死。

当然，还有很多人和我们一样憎恨兽人，我们可能会发现自己在路上有奇怪的盟友。
description.text_en:
Before the Greentide breached through Khugdihr and spilled into Escann, the goblin slave Rurnor Snotfinger led a group of fellow goblin slaves into the nearby caverns, avoiding the fate of those who would become the Common Goblins. Every goblin of Snotfinger knows this story well, and knows the truth of why there can never be peace with orcs. They all must die.

Of course, there are many others who share our hatred of the orcs, and we may find ourselves with strange allies along the way.

description.text: 粗鄙中指氏族是通过我们逃离兽人的奴役而存在的，我们中没有人打算再回到兽人的奴役中。没有一个粗鄙中指地精会再次成为奴隶。尽管自由可能伴随着它自己的问题，但我们通过它们来忍受，因为我们知道另一个选择是什么。
description.text_en: The Snotfinger clan came into existence through our escape from orcish slavery, and none of us have any intention of returning to it. No Snotfinger goblin will ever be a slave again. And though freedom may come with its own problems, we suffer through them, knowing what the alternative is.

description.text: 在鼻涕穴的深处，有一个巨大地精学习综合体，被称为粗鄙中指大学，成立于1476年，以鲁尔诺尔·粗鄙中指命名。由粗鄙中指氏族的地精们建立的工程学校，随着时间的推移，它将成为一个具有自身价值的城市。其目的最终是为了教育下一代的地精武器制造专家和工程师，以及让他们和他们的实验品安全地远离他们可能炸毁的重要东西。
description.text_en: Within the depths of Snotslair lies a great complex of goblin learning known as Snotfinger University, founded in 1476 AA and named after Rurnor Snotfinger. Established by the goblins of the Snotfinger Clan as a school of engineering, in time it would become a city on its own merits. The purpose would end up being to both educate the next generation of expert goblin weapon-makers and engineers, as well as keep them and their experiments safely away from where they might blow up something actually important.

description.text: 即使在绿潮期间，蛇脊山脉也远未被兽人清空。杜坎森会派大量的战队回到山里，召集兽人战士，抓捕地精奴隶。这将导致断链战争，粗鄙中指氏族伏击前往东坎诺的兽人奴隶主，并解放地精同胞。一些人加入了粗鄙中指氏族，增强了该氏族的数量，并进一步确保该氏族能够经受住进一步的争斗。
description.text_en: Even during the Greentide, the Serpentspine was far from emptied of orcs. Dookanson would send plenty of warbands back into the mountains to rally orcish warriors and capture goblin slaves. This would lead to the Chainbreaker Wars, where the Snotfinger Clan would ambush orcish slavers making their way to Escann and liberate fellow goblins. Some would join with the Snotfinger Clan, bolstering the clan's numbers and further ensuring that the clan could withstand further struggles.

effects.display: 战斗中获得的陆军传统：+0.25
effects.label_zh: 战斗中获得的陆军传统

description.text: 随着绿潮的结束，东坎诺的开垦和矮人返回矮人之地，导致粗鄙中指氏族陷入了一个巨大的困难时期。然而，随着时间的推移，与地面的贸易将被建立起来。不同于传统的矮人，地精在商业伙伴和收购方法上的顾虑都少得多。地精与矮人不同，他们更有能力提取隐藏在蛇脊山脉隧道和洞穴中的财富。随着东坎诺市场的重新开放，我们自然要拿走我们的公平份额，尤其是那些因「谋杀」或「走私」等小事而被矮人不公平地拒绝的人。当然，多拿一点钱来资助战争和其他工作，只是在矮人之地做可靠、有信誉的生意的代价。
description.text_en: With the end of the Greentide, the reclamation of Escann and dwarves returning to the Dwarovar led to a time of great difficulty for Clan Snotfinger. In time, however, trade with the surface would be established. Unlike the hidebound and traditional dwarves, Goblins have far fewer scruples in both business partners and methods of acquisition. Goblins, unlike dwarves, are far more capable in extracting the wealth hidden away in the tunnels and caverns of the Serpentspine. With markets in Escann reopening, it is only natural for us to take our fair share, especially with those unfairly turned away by the dwarves for petty things like "Murder" or "Smuggling". Of course, taking a little bit extra off the top to finance wars and other endeavors is just the price of doing solid, reputable business in the Dwarovar

description.text:
快活水是由粗鄙中指的工匠斯洛巴尔德·窃饼者发明的一种强效药物，最初设计它是为了让他永远保持清醒，从而提高工作效率。制作完成后，斯洛巴尔德迅速而有效地发现了继续饮用快活水的致命副作用。

幸运的是，他的女儿兼实验室助理奇赫丝意识到这项发明仍然有应用价值，同时也减少了每杯的用量。现在，它被用来帮助粗鄙中指的士兵击退撤退的敌人，给他们以爆发的速度和能量，以确保没有敌人逃跑免于再次战斗。
description.text_en:
Invented by the Snotfinger inventor Slobald Piestealer, Gojuice is a potent concoction originally designed to keep him awake forever, thereby increasing productivity. After making it, Slobald quickly, and fatally, discovered the lethal side effects of continued consumption of his invention.

Thankfully his daughter and lab assistant Qihx was able to save the recipe, while also reducing the dosage per cup. It is now used to help Snotfinger soldiers run down retreating enemies, giving them a burst of speed and energy to ensure that none of the enemy escape to fight again.

name.text: 斯洛巴尔德·窃饼者的快活水

description.text: 我们的土地被称为蜘蛛巢是有原因的。在这里发现的大量巨型蜘蛛不仅是战争中的坐骑，也是制作轻便且极其坚固的盔甲的蜘蛛丝的来源。通过用这种材料装备我们的先锋部队，我们可以创建一支融合了重骑兵和轻骑兵优势的精锐部队。
description.text_en: Our lands are called the Spidernest for good reason. The abundant giant spiders found here are not only useful as mounts in war but as plentiful sources of spider silk, a material that makes for light yet surprisingly strong armor when woven correctly. By cladding our vanguard forces in this material, we can create a tough, durable, and yet mobile form of cavalry.

description.text: 毒酿是一种特殊的酒精，它是由某些有毒的蛇花栽培物、洞穴真菌和最后各种蜘蛛毒液的精心调制蒸馏而成。众所周知，这种酒除了最小的量之外，喝了之后会产生致幻的幻觉，使它成为艺术家和发明家的最爱。过度使用会导致内部器官腐烂，暂时或永久瘫痪，以及死亡。
description.text_en: Venombrew is a special type of alcohol, made from the careful distillation of certain toxic cultivations of Serpentsbloom, cave fungus, and finally a careful concoction of various spider venoms. The drink is known to cause hallucinogenic visions when imbibed in all but the smallest amounts, making it a favorite of artists and inventors. Overuse can lead to decay of internal organs, temporary or permanent paralysis, and death.

description.text: 矮人之地蜿蜒曲折的洞穴为许多自给自足的小镇的形成创造了理想的条件。虽然很难控制和对这些完全不同的定居点征税，但这确实允许当地人将利润再投资于他们的经济活动，导致地方一级的更大增长。通过任命当地人作为我们的代表，这应该有望使投诉也保持在当地水平。
description.text_en: The winding and labyrinthine caverns of the Dwarovar create ideal conditions for the formation of many small self-sufficient townships. While it can be difficult to control and tax these disparate settlements, it does allow the locals to reinvest their profits in their economic activities, leading to larger growth on a local level. By appointing local individuals as our representatives, this should hopefully keep complaints to a local level as well.

description.text: 虽然我们在本质上永远是洞穴居民，但我们的领域触及一个巨大的无顶洞，它是黑暗和光明并存的。这里居住着奇怪的、四条腿的战争生物，他们的躯干、手臂和头部都是身材匀称、高大的矮人。根据我们的观察，他们不仅从对方那里寻求血腥和暴力，而且还从挥舞着巨大的大棒和胃口的大而肥的双腿生物那里寻求血腥和暴力。
description.text_en: While we will always always be cave dwellers by nature, our realm touches a great roofless cave that is dark and light in equal measure. It is inhabited by strange, four-legged beings of war with the torsos, arms, and head of well built, taller dwarves. From our observations, they seek bloodshed and violence in equal measure from not only each other, but large, fat two legged beings wielding great big clubs and appetites to match.

description.text: 一支地精侦察队主动与这些大胖子中的一个取得了联系，他们最近用棍子打死了两个四脚兽。侦察队以地精对兽人之间惯例的打招呼方式——也就是为了活命哭丧着脸求饶，并把队伍中最弱的一个——「水牛」斯纳夫利克斯作为奖品，以增进关系。出乎意料的是，大胖子的手把斯纳夫利克斯提溜起来，用绳子把他绑在腰带上，并从自己肥胖的身躯上撬下来的几件骨头和金首饰送给了侦察队。斯纳夫利克斯，一个众所周知的出老千者不会被人怀念，而进一步的、更互利的安排的可能性使族中许多人兴奋不已——他们不介意摆脱一些恼人的亲属。
description.text_en: A single goblin scouting party took it upon themselves to make contact with one of these large fat individuals, who had recently clubbed two of the Four-Legs to death. They had made the usual goblin to orc greeting, which is to snivel for their lives, making an offering of the weakest of the group- Snarflix the Dribbly, as a prize in order to foster relations. Surprisingly, the fat Two-Legs picked up Snarflix, tied him with a rope to his belt, and presented the group a few pieces of bone and gold jewelry, pried from its fat, rotund form. Snarflix, a known cheater at dice will not be missed, and the possibility of further, more mutually beneficial arrangements excites many in the clan who would not mind being rid of some annoying relatives.

description.text: 我们一次又一次地看到无顶洞的四条腿的漫游者，他们从蔓延到大空地的洞穴中，是移动战争的高手。同样，古老的矮人也有他们的公羊领主和粗壮的野兽，其中一些存活至今，主要是作为现在居住在蛇谷的地精和食人魔的家畜。虽然我们选择的坐骑更多是肉食性的，但两者所采用的许多经验都可以以这样或那样的方式为我们所用。
description.text_en: The four-legged roamers of the Roofless Cavern, whom we have seen time and time again from the caves which spill into the big empty flats, are masters of mobile warfare. As well, the dwarves of old had their ram-lords and their stocky beasts, some of which survive today, mostly as livestock for the goblins and ogres who now dwell in the Serpent's Vale. While our mounts of choice are far more carnivorous, many of the lessons both employed can be adapted in one way or another for our use.

description.text: 利用我们对炼金术、蜘蛛毒液和其他天然致幻剂的了解，我们的药剂师已经设计出几种炼金术混合物，旨在在战场上散布恐怖和混乱。这仅仅是酿造毒药和其他有趣的毒药的长期和传奇传统中的下一步。这些炸弹非常有威力，极有能力摧毁坚固的阵地，以及扰乱敌人的阵型，使他们在我们的冲锋陷阵面前不堪一击。建议在狭小的空间内使用时要小心谨慎。我们自己的战士有一次被卷入爆炸中，很搞笑，但族长希望它不要再发生。
description.text_en: Utilizing our knowledge of alchemy, spider venoms, and other natural hallucinagens, our potion-makers have devised several alchemical concoctions designed to spread terror and confusion on the battlefield. This is merely the next step in a long and storied tradition of brewing Venombrew and other interesting poisons. Very potent, these bombs are extremely capable of devastating entrenched positions, as well as disrupting enemy formations and making them vulnerable to our charging crawlers. Caution is advised for usage in small spaces. Our own warriors getting caught in the blast once was hilarious, but the Clanboss would prefer it not happen again.

player_overview.avoid_if: 不想为形成条件和任务门槛做长期准备，或讨厌灾难与高风险财政玩法的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先用指定洞穴哥布林部族统一西蛇脊，再经营五派政治、财政和狂飙，推动工业、探险与奇械战争。
player_overview.overview: 你先从西蛇脊的洞穴哥布林部族出发，统一同族并形成众氏族之国。此后让发明家、营造者、药业集团、密探和探险者互相争权，把铁路、奇械、工厂与火箭铺进地下。国家越繁荣，建造狂热、金融事故和派系内斗也越难无视：这是一场把混乱当生产力的长线战役。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢复杂形成国、工程爆发、派系拉扯与哥布林黑色幽默的玩家。
signature_features: 五派技术官僚共和国与有利有弊的狂飙资源。
把建筑狂热当推进工具，同时承受事故和后续收拾残局。
铁路、地下探险、奇械军备和荒诞工业灾难交织成独特叙事。
player_overview.tagline: 五个哥布林部族，五派共和国，一座快要把自己炸上天的地下工业帝国。

reasons: 形成后的五派共和与狂飙循环极具辨识度
地下工业、铁路和奇械贯穿长线任务
荒诞喜剧与灾难代价并存
warnings: 先要完成高门槛的部族统一
派系与灾难可拖慢任务推进
高风险工业与财政实验不适合稳健种田偏好

positive_indicators: 洞穴哥布林获得统一政体
部分任务推动摆脱怪物化地位
values.rationale: 住房、就业和哥布林整合提供公共利益；但任务剧情中的可避免工业伤亡、金融欺诈和生命安全外部化显著压低尊严与克制。评分没有因哥布林身份、扩张或共和国本身加减分；灾难与选项的具体游玩结果未做实机核验。
red_flags: 可预见的工业事故仍被推进
安全成本转嫁给邻境与平民
强制汲取与高风险金融实验
